name: mise-webgl-monorepo
description: MISE WebGL framework monorepo — mise-webgl, mise-ui, mise-php, and docs consumer.

scripts.release:publish: npm run verify:ci && npm run build:mise && changeset publish
scripts.lint:project: npm run test:web-foundation-policy && npm run score:web-foundation
scripts.verify:web-foundation: npm run verify --workspace mise-ui && npm run verify --workspace mise-php && npm run verify --workspace mise-docs
scripts.verify:web-foundation:ci: npm run verify --workspace mise-ui && npm run verify --workspace mise-php
scripts.package:mise: npm run verify:framework --workspace mise-webgl && node scripts/package-mise.mjs && node scripts/verify-mise-tarball.mjs && node scripts/verify-mise-dogfood.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run lint:project && npm run test:security-headers && npm run typecheck && npm run package:mise && npm run package:web-foundation && npm run test:mise:mutation
scripts.verify:ci: npm run lint:project && npm run test:security-headers && npm run typecheck && npm run package:mise && npm run package:web-foundation:ci
